questions.title: Which candidate will receive the most “encourage” votes in the first UN Security Council straw poll of the 2026 secretary-general selection?
questions.background: António Guterres is serving as UN secretary-general. Informal Security Council straw polls gauge support for potential successors, with members indicating whether they encourage, discourage or have no opinion on each candidate.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official UN information or contemporaneous reporting by reputable international news organizations describing the first Security Council straw poll in the 2026 secretary-general selection process. Resolution Condition : Resolve to the candidate receiving the highest number of “encourage” votes in that first poll, regardless of subsequent polls or the final appointment. Accepted Answer Format : The candidate’s full name.

questions.title: Which European country will announce plans to shut down its only nuclear power plant because of drought-related cooling-water shortages by August 2, 2026?
questions.background: Nuclear power plants that use river water for cooling can face operational restrictions when drought reduces the available water supply.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official government statements or contemporaneous reporting by established news organizations. Resolution Rule : Identify the European country whose government announces, between July 1 and August 2, 2026, inclusive, plans for a complete shutdown of its sole operating nuclear power plant because drought has reduced the river water available for reactor cooling. The announcement of the shutdown plan is sufficient; the shutdown itself need not have occurred. A partial reduction in electricity output alone does not qualify. Accepted Answer Format : The country's commonly used English name.
questions.current_reasoning: Major 2026-07-20 to 2026-07-23 hydrologic escalation along the Danube flips the ranking sharply toward Romania and Hungary (Reuters, Libertatea/G4Media, ATV.hu, Power Trading News Europe): (1) Romania surges 0.27 -> 0.38 (new #1): Danube flow at Romania's entry plunged to 1,650-1,700 m3/s (lowest in 30 years since 1996 vs. 4,700 normal), forcing authorities to activate emergency irrigation restrictions on the Calarasi-Cernavoda stretch and execute controlled water releases from Olt and Arges reservoirs specifically to maintain minimum cooling flow for Cernavoda's two reactors; Apele Romane warned July 21 that recent rains failed to lift Danube flow, which is projected to stay near 1,700-1,750 m3/s through at least July 27, leaving Cernavoda (tight 15 cm gap between Unit 1/2 shutdown thresholds and 2003 shutdown precedent) acutely exposed. (2) Hungary climbs 0.20 -> 0.26 (new #2): BME nuclear engineering dean Attila Aszodi warned on ATV.hu (July 21) that the Danube at Paks fell 6 cm below its all-time record low (-104 cm Friday, -71 cm Tuesday), all three cooling parameters (temperature, level, flow) hit critical marks simultaneously, Paks was 'only a few cm' from a turbine shutdown and 25-30 cm from a complete plant shutdown, and 'we are not past the hardest part' (moderated slightly vs. Romania because Paks has 4 units with staged shutdown buffering). (3) Slovenia drops 0.36 -> 0.21 (#3): no mid/late-July Krsko cooling alerts, Krsko's auxiliary cooling towers held 100% power through June's heatwave, and Reuters (July 21) reported storms spreading directly into Slovenia—though single-reactor exposure keeps it a serious #3. Bulgaria (Kozloduy, 0.14 -> 0.13) faces the same record-low Danube (lowest since 1946 in Serbia) without reported cooling alerts yet; Belarus trims 0.02 -> 0.01 (sum 0.99).

questions.background: Bruno Guimaraes joined Newcastle United from Lyon in January 2022 and has established himself as a prominent Premier League midfielder.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : An official announcement from Newcastle United or the receiving club confirming a completed permanent transfer during the 2026 summer transfer window. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the receiving club in the first completed permanent transfer of Guimaraes from Newcastle United during that window. Loan moves, reported interest and unconfirmed agreements do not qualify. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the receiving football club.
questions.current_reasoning: Decisive July 6-16 transfer shift following Brazil's World Cup exit to Norway (July 5) and Newcastle's sales of Anthony Gordon (Barcelona) and Sandro Tonali (Tottenham, £100m): BBC Sport (Sami Mokbel & Ciaran Kelly, July 8) broke that Bruno Guimaraes has formally asked to leave Newcastle as Premier League champions Arsenal accelerate their pursuit; L'Equipe (via Evening Standard, July 14) reported Guimaraes has agreed personal terms with Arsenal on a five-year deal until 2031; and Sports Mole/Sport Witness (July 16) reported Arsenal had a £65m opening bid rejected (preparing a higher €90m bid per Nicolo Schira) while Guimaraes' agency Bertolucci Sports drives talks with Arsenal and offers Newcastle Botafogo's Danilo as a replacement. Meanwhile PlanetFootball (July 8) and Standard (July 14) note Man City (holding Rodri/Kovacic/Anderson) and Man Utd (cold trail, pursuing Tielemans) are not actively bidding. Promoting Arsenal sharply from 0.19 -> 0.55—capped at 0.55 under our unconfirmed-transfer discipline because Newcastle still demand £100m/€120m (a valuation gap that let Spurs hijack Tonali from Arsenal)—with Real Madrid (0.11), Manchester City (0.10, down from 0.24), Barcelona (0.06, cited by TEAMtalk as monitoring), and PSG (0.05) capturing hijack risk alongside 13% residual.

questions.title: Who will win Michigan’s 2026 Democratic primary for U.S. Senate?
questions.background: Michigan will elect a U.S. senator in November 2026. The Democratic primary will determine the party’s nominee for that election.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Results from Michigan election authorities or unambiguous reporting by major news organizations identifying the winner of Michigan’s 2026 Democratic primary for U.S. Senate. Resolution Date : Resolve when the winner of the primary, scheduled for August 4, 2026, is publicly established. Accepted Answer Format : The winning candidate’s name.
questions.current_reasoning: Major 2026-07-13 to 2026-07-20 recalibration across polling, endorsements, and liquid prediction markets: outgoing Sen. Gary Peters endorsed Haley Stevens on July 13 (CBS News); WDIV/Detroit News/Glengariff Group's live-operator phone poll (July 8-11, n=500) put Stevens ahead 48.2%-41.4% (+6.8, though 'definite' voters are virtually tied 34.1%-33.7% and El-Sayed holds a higher +36.1 vs +28.5 net favorability); Tavern Research (July 6-7, n=2,200+) had Stevens +3 (41%-38%), giving Stevens a 45%-41% (+4) RealClearPolitics average as of July 15-20 (Detroit Free Press, Washington Examiner). Offsetting that, Data for Progress (July 16) still puts El-Sayed up +13, Bernie Sanders and AOC rallied with El-Sayed in Michigan on July 20 (CBS News), and early absentee ballots have been cast since early July. Crucially, liquid prediction markets (~$3.3M+ combined volume) repriced sharply from El-Sayed's 82%-87% peak down to 66%-34% on Kalshi ($2.4M+) and ~67%-33% on Polymarket ($900k+) as of July 16-20 (DeFi Rate, Washington Examiner). Blending ~70% liquid market consensus (66%) with ~30% fundamentals/polling (~55% given Glengariff's live-phone track record, Peters' post-poll endorsement, and heavy establishment TV spending) shifts Abdul El-Sayed down 0.77 -> 0.63 and Haley Stevens up 0.23 -> 0.37.

local_articles.snippet: With less than two weeks before the Michigan primary election, Gov. Gretchen Whitmer endorsed Democratic Congresswoman Haley Stevens in the contentious U.S. Senate race. In a video shared by Stevens on social media, Whitmer said Stevens is "as Michigan as it gets." The governor cited Stevens helping "save the auto industry" during the Obama administration, pushing for lower prescription drugs and fighting against defunding Social Security. "Haley will do whatever it takes to get things done for the people of Michigan, and we need her now more than ever," Whitmer said in the video. questions.title: Which country will host Ye Win Oo's first overseas visit as Myanmar's military chief?
questions.background: Ye Win Oo assumed Myanmar's military leadership in April 2026 after Min Aung Hlaing became president.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official statements from the governments involved or contemporaneous reporting by major international news organizations identifying the destination of Ye Win Oo's first overseas visit after assuming military leadership in April 2026. Resolution Timing : Resolve once the visit has begun and is publicly confirmed, rather than when travel plans are merely announced. Accepted Answer Format : The destination country's common English name.
questions.current_reasoning: General Ye Win Oo assumed Myanmar's top military post on March 30, 2026 and remained in Naypyidaw through June 15, 2026 (seeing off President Min Aung Hlaing for his Beijing state visit). China is the foremost candidate for Ye Win Oo's debut foreign trip to coordinate CMC/PLA defense and border-security ties following Min Aung Hlaing's June visit. Thailand is a very strong second because Thai Defense Forces Chief Gen Ukris Boontanondha visited Naypyidaw on March 19 (with Ye Win Oo attending) specifically to prepare the upcoming Myanmar-Thailand Armed Forces High-Level Committee meeting; Russia (top arms supplier, late-July Navy Day / August defense forums) and India (Indian Navy chief was the first foreign military leader Ye Win Oo met in May 2026) follow, with 5% on Belarus/Vietnam/Cambodia.
